caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a brown rim and a yellowish-brown interior surface. In the center of the plate, there is an illustration of a bird with a patterned body in shades of brown, green, and yellow, perched among branches. The branches have numerous leaves colored in green, brown, and muted red tones, radiating outward from the bird and filling the inner circle of the plate. There are small green circular shapes scattered among the leaves. Around the bird and foliage, near the edge of the plate, there is a ring of cursive script in a dark color. The drawing is executed on a light beige rectangular background, with the plate itself being positioned centrally. The artist’s signature, "M. L. Friedrich," appears in red ink near the lower right edge of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
